rules.cite: Santa Ana, CA Rent Stabilization Ordinance
rules.coverage_text: Residential buildings constructed on or before February 1, 1995, excluding mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990.

exemptions.quote: The rent cap does not apply to residential buildings constructed after February 1, 1995, or to mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990.

exemptions.description: Mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990

key_values.name: cpi_percentage_applied
key_values.text: 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period

rules.quote: Increase in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period. If the CPI is negative, no rent increase is permitted.
rules.requirement: Residential rent increases are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period. If the CPI is negative, no rent increase is permitted.
rules.title: Annual Rent Increase Cap

rules.cite: Santa Ana, CA Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.coverage_text: Residential rental property excluding housing produced in the last 15 years, deed-restricted affordable housing, hotel and transient occupancy, hospital and care facilities, dormitories, and other shared living quarters.

exemptions.description: Housing produced in the last 15 years
exemptions.quote: The Just Cause Ordinance shall not apply to certain types of residential property, including housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; and other shared living quarters.

exemptions.description: Hotel and transient occupancy, hospital and care facilities, dormitories, and other shared living quarters

rules.quote: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice.
rules.requirement: After 30 days of tenancy, a landlord may not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which must be stated in a written notice.
rules.title: Just Cause Eviction Requirement

rules.cite: Santa Ana, CA Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.coverage_text: All residential rental properties subject to the Just Cause Eviction Ordinance.

key_values.name: at_fault_cause_types
key_values.text: default in payment of rent, breach of a material term of the lease, committing a nuisance, criminal activity, and other actions

rules.quote: "Just cause" includes certain at-fault causes such as default in payment of rent, breach of a material term of the lease, committing a nuisance, criminal activity, and other actions.
rules.requirement: Just cause for eviction may include at-fault causes such as default in payment of rent, breach of a material term of the lease, committing a nuisance, criminal activity, and other actions.
rules.title: At-Fault Just Cause Grounds for Eviction

rules.cite: Santa Ana, CA Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.coverage_text: All residential rental properties subject to the Just Cause Eviction Ordinance.

key_values.name: no_fault_cause_types
key_values.text: intent of the owner to occupy the property, removal of the property from the rental market, and demolition or substantial remodel

rules.quote: "Just cause" also includes certain no-fault causes such as the intent of the owner to occupy the property, removal of the property from the rental market, and demolition or substantial remodel.
rules.requirement: Just cause for eviction may include no-fault causes such as the intent of the owner to occupy the property, removal of the property from the rental market, and demolition or substantial remodel.
rules.title: No-Fault Just Cause Grounds for Eviction

rules.cite: Santa Ana, CA Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.coverage_text: All residential rental properties subject to the Just Cause Eviction Ordinance.
rules.quote: Before issuing a notice to terminate for just cause, the owner shall first give notice of the violation with a time period for the tenant to fix the violation(s).
rules.requirement: Before issuing a notice to terminate for just cause, the owner must first give notice of the violation with a time period for the tenant to fix the violation(s).
rules.title: Pre-Termination Notice and Cure Period

rules.cite: Santa Ana, CA Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.coverage_text: All residential rental properties subject to the Just Cause Eviction Ordinance.

key_values.name: rent_waiver_months
key_values.text: waive payment of rent for the final 3 months

rules.quote: Under a no-fault just cause termination, the owner shall either provide 3 months of relocation assistance or waive payment of rent for the final 3 months of the tenancy.
rules.requirement: Under a no-fault just cause termination, the owner shall either provide 3 months of relocation assistance or waive payment of rent for the final 3 months of the tenancy.
rules.title: No-Fault Eviction Relocation Assistance
